name: FIMACOR
recent: FIMACOR 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日召开第 51 届常年股东大会，所有决议案均获通过。一名董事于 8 月 20 日以间接方式增持 10,000 股普通股。公司也按月公布种植 / 木材生产数据，并发布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
notable: 第 51 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 1 日举行，所有决议案均获股东通过。

recent_en: FIMACOR held its 51st Annual General Meeting on 1 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed. A director acquired 10,000 ordinary shares indirectly on 20 August. The company also released monthly production figures for plantation/timber and announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: The 51st Annual General Meeting was held on 1 September 2026, and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
Director Rezal Zain bin Abdul Rashid acquired 10,000 ordinary shares indirectly on 20 August 2026.
